slides.title: 5 cleaning myths that make your house harder to clean

slides.fact: Water utilities say to keep every wipe out of the toilet, whatever the package says. In one lab soak, toilet paper dissolved in 5 minutes and wipes barely broke down in 24 hours.

slides.myth: Vinegar is safe on every surface.
slides.fact: It's an acid. On marble and other natural stone it can etch the surface and dull the finish, and it can break down a granite sealer.
Bleach mixed with ammonia or with an acid like vinegar gives off toxic gas. Use one product at a time, and keep the room ventilated.
They don't clean it, they add fragrance chemicals to it. The odor source is still there. For airborne particles, a true HEPA air cleaner does the work.

slides.myth: Spray, wipe right away, and it's disinfected.
slides.fact: Disinfectants need to stay visibly wet for the contact time on the label. Wiping it off early cuts that short.
